Package com.j3d.storage.files.protocol.proj

Class PF2

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.storage.files.protocol.GenericFileProtocol
com.j3d.storage.files.protocol.proj.ProjectFile
com.j3d.storage.files.protocol.proj.PF2
All Implemented Interfaces:
FileProtocol
public class PF2 extends ProjectFile
PF2 is a J3D file protocol implementation for reading and writing project files that contain layer and thing information to and from disk.

Typically .j3p files

This version is different from PF1 as it makes the following changes: (in the format 0xAARRGGBB)

  • Writes GObject.getColour()invalid input: '<'/li
  • Writes GObject.getColour()
  • Changes GTri's 4 colour ints to be 1 singular signed 32 bit int.

The Exact format is as follows:

    J3D Header (UTF-8)
    J3D Version (int)
    PROJECT Header (UTF-8)
    PROJECT Header Version (int)
    Number of Layers (int)
    For each Layer:
      Layer Identifier (UTF-8)
      Layer Hidden (boolean)
    Number of points in project (int)
    For each point:
      Point UUID (UTF-8)
      Thing Parent UUID (UTF-8)
      X Coordinate (double)
      Y Coordinate (double)
      Z Coordinate (double)
      Point Colour (signed 32 bit int) (Different from PF1)
    Number of lines in project (int)
    For each line:
      Line UUID (UTF-8)
      Thing Parent UUID (UTF-8)
      Line Colour (signed 32 bit int) (Different from PF1)
      Start Point UUID (UTF-8)
      End Point UUID (UTF-8)
    Number of triangles in project (int)
    For each triangle:
      Triangle UUID (UTF-8)
      Thing Parent UUID (UTF-8)
      Tri colour (signed 32 bit int) (Different from PF1)
      Line 1 UUID (UTF-8)
      Line 2 UUID (UTF-8)
      Line 3 UUID (UTF-8)
    For each Layer:
      Layer Index (int)
      Number of Things in Layer (int)
      For each Thing:
        Thing UUID (UTF-8)
        Thing Name (UTF-8)
        Thing Visibility (boolean)
        ... Multiple lines UUIDs of lines points and tris that the thing owns (UTF-8)
